name: pathpilot-ai
description: Network change safety gate for human and AI proposed changes

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/lab.js && node --check public/core/proposal.js && node --check src/ai-proposal.js && node --check cli.js && node --test && node scripts/export-emulation-reports.js --check
scripts.verify:blocked: node cli.js verify --lab public/labs/frr/lab.json --baseline public/labs/frr/baseline --candidate public/labs/frr/candidates/route-leak --provenance ai
scripts.verify:safe: node cli.js verify --lab public/labs/frr/lab.json --baseline public/labs/frr/baseline --candidate public/labs/frr/candidates/safe-reroute --provenance ai
scripts.proposal:blocked: node cli.js verify --lab public/labs/frr/lab.json --baseline public/labs/frr/baseline --proposal public/labs/frr/proposals/route-leak.json --provenance ai
scripts.proposal:safe: node cli.js verify --lab public/labs/frr/lab.json --baseline public/labs/frr/baseline --proposal public/labs/frr/proposals/safe-reroute.json --provenance ai
